verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI can run entire collections/folders of requests in one command (with data-driven testing across many data sets) and Bruno AI can generate whole collections—requests, tests, and docs—from source code in a single action, both enabling bulk work across many items. However, there is no evidence of finer-grained bulk operations like batch-editing/renaming multiple existing requests, variables, or environments at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-rename UI or API across existing items, independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale bulk runs.
